notes.title: Chapter 2 is now live!
notes.content:
Greetings!

The journey of Soulforged continues! It's now a little over a year since the Early Access launch and the game has been expanded and improved in many ways. But the biggest update yet has just been made available - Soulforged Chapter 2 is now live! Here's what you can expect from this new chapter:
[list]
[*] The available landmass is now more than doubled!
[*] A music system - discover how to play musical instruments and inspire fellow players!
[*] New and exciting threat! Stay vigilant as you trek the newly opened lands.
[*] Offhand combat equipment to help you brave the new challenges!
[*] 63 new craftable items
[*] 35 new character powers
[*] 12 new creatures
[*] ...and a handful more new smaller features!
[/list]


But the new Chapter is not everything that you may find was added to the game! Over the last year the game saw multitude of additions and improvements!

[list]
[*] Updated tutorial - the first step is often the most difficult. The game now includes additional trackable steps that help you navigate through the early steps!
[*] Mortal wounds - an encounter going awry doesn't have to mean it's the end of your character. A mortal wound system provides your character with a chance to continue their journey.
[*] Increased AP limit - as you work to complete early game milestone you will see your maximum Action Points pool to grow, providing you with more flexibility with your play sessions.
[/list]

Consider joining the community on our Discord: https://discord.gg/XExbewT5GQ !

F.A.Q.
Q. How much does this expansion cost?
A. All of the Chapter 2 contents, same as all the content available previously, is available completely for free.

Q. I didn't play in a while. How do I catch up to play Chapter 2 content?
A. The lands added in Chapter 2 can be reached relatively easily and there's room there for all characters, regardless of their power and equipment, to find something to pursue there.
